title: Shared information governs multi-view planted matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.32892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study when the rows of $K$ shuffled views of the same $n$ objects can be matched, where each object is observed once in every view through a Gaussian feature vector with known covariance. For every fixed $K$, all views can be matched up to $o(n)$ errors if the shared information $J$ of one object's $K$ observations exceeds $(1+\epsilon)\log n$, and not if it is below $(1-\epsilon)\log n$; this can hold although no two views can be matched on their own. Below the threshold, two views can still be matched if some set of views containing both has shared information above $\log n$; otherwise every estimator, even one that reads all views, has vanishing overlap between them. Matching every row is governed by the weakest bipartition of the views: with weak correlations the threshold is $2\log n$ for the mutual information across it. translated_title: 共享信息决定多视图植入匹配
translated_abstract: 我们研究同一 n 个对象的 K 个被打乱顺序的视图的行何时可以相互匹配，其中每个对象在每个视图中通过具有已知协方差的高斯特征向量被观测一次。对于每个固定的 K，若单个对象的 K 次观测之间的共享信息 J 超过 (1+ε)log n，则所有视图可以在 o(n) 误差内全部匹配；若低于 (1−ε)log n 则不能；即使任意两个视图自身无法匹配，上述情形仍可能发生。在阈值以下，若存在某个同时包含这两个视图的视图集合、其共享信息高于 log n，则这两个视图仍然可以匹配；否则，任何估计器——即使读取全部视图——在这两个视图之间的重叠都会趋于消失。能否匹配每一行由视图的最弱二分划分所控制：在弱相关情形下，跨越该划分的互信息阈值为 2log n。对于通过独立噪声观测到的弱共同信号，两个阈值分别为 4/K 和 4/(K−1)（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明对同一 n 个对象的 K 个打乱视图能否全部匹配由对象观测间的共享信息精确决定——共享信息超过 (1+ε)log n 时可匹配至 o(n) 误差、低于 (1−ε)log n 时不可能，且整体可匹配性由视图最弱二分划分的互信息阈值 2log n 控制，弱共同信号下两个阈值分别为 4/K 与 4/(K−1)。
en_tdlr: Matching all K shuffled views of n Gaussian-observed objects is exactly governed by shared information: it is possible up to o(n) errors when shared information exceeds (1+ε)log n and impossible below (1−ε)log n, with the overall threshold set by the weakest view bipartition's mutual information (2log n under weak correlations) and thresholds 4/K and 4/(K−1) for a weak common signal.
